introduction: Follow the dragon-heart introduction, recover Gilandrimeel’s horn and Banitoor’s staff, and return two distinct half amulets for centaur honor. Optional briefings, supplied items and access guidance explain the entire chain without forcing personal kills or earlier producer history.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Centaur Villages has its own achievement. All seven native exchanges are explained: four story outcomes and three optional inspection or briefing services. Actual item sources, offering/reward publication, fresh Hateeu availability and daily renewal remain unqualified.

The main story runs from Naergot’s heart to Llewyn’s letter, then the returned unicorn horn and a half amulet, followed by Banitoor’s recovered staff and a second half, then Hateeu’s two-item reward. The letter and amulet briefings explain the story without becoming mandatory personal history. Supplied exact items can enter at any offering stage.

Both amulet halves use the same kind 93313. Hateeu needs two separate loose carried items together; one half cannot count twice. Their different story sources do not create two different named kinds. The bracelet 93314, legplates 93330, unicorn pendant and oak ring are different items and cannot replace a half.

From Surface grassland 519684, go north to pass 93300. Northern Wilderness 12269 also has a northward entrance to that pass, but the pass’s southern return leads to Surface. Follow the mountain path north through 93301–93304, climb through 93305 and 93306, and cross river rooms 93307–93308 to grotto 93310. The two incline rooms have real fall chances; arrival, protection and surviving return are separate from simply knowing the route.

Naergot’s cave branches west from incline 93305 to 93397, then south to lair 93398. The granite slab is exit-description scenery; there is no local declared blocked/locked gate on this cave branch. The lair has no-recall and no-summon flags. Its treasure horde is a static container, without a reviewed native treasure-opening quest.

Llewyn’s island is room 93335 amid the Lake of Elders. The lake and river have real water sectors. Four river rooms declare currents: 93337 and 93338 flow east, while 93341 and 93349 flow south. Currents can move you on arrival or before a requested command and can resist an upstream move. Flight or levitation affects admission; a water-room visit is not a safe-crossing achievement.

The treant elder starts in grove clearing 93366. From forest entrance 93357, the route through 93359–93360 reaches vine-blocked 93363 north to 93365, then west to the clearing. PUSH the local vines to clear the reciprocal route when blocked. A second vine-controlled approach connects 93377 north with 93375 south. The four controls are type-29 items, distinct from the staff container despite sharing the vines alias.

The horn is in Haornig’s backpack at his starting arch 93317. The crooked staff is in the separate vine container at glen dead end 93370, south of intersection 93369 west of the treant clearing. The backpack and staff-container resets declare a kind, not a guaranteed UID. Move required contents into loose carried inventory before an offering. Possession does not establish the source or who recovered it.

Tamilea’s forest clearing 93386 is reached from the paths west and east at 93385 and 93387. Ask her about the Learned One for Banitoor’s history. Her clue now matches Banitoor’s cave on the eastern edge of the plains: PUSH rock at 93326, then enter the eastern route to 93399. The rock clears the blocked eastern side and the reciprocal western side; her cave’s return is separately reset open.

Llewyn resets carrying a recommendation letter; the treant elder and Banitoor each reset carrying the same half-amulet kind under its shared live cap of two. These are real source alternatives independent of your personal story receipts, whose actual retrieval and ownership still need qualification. Same-kind inspections consume and return a kind, without promising physical identity preservation.

Hateeu starts at plains room 93330 and retires after the accepted two-half completion. The recipe declares both bracelet and legplates as rewards; receipt credit, each published item, removal of Hateeu, reset reappearance and fresh material supply are distinct facts. A retained receipt does not prove both rewards are currently held or that the quest can immediately repeat.

The clearing at 93373 and Banitoor’s cave have actual healing flags; neither is an inn. The treant and Llewyn offer separate class/level guidance. Guardian or wolf followers, grief, family history, a spell to cure age, a protector title, fruit trees, ponds and the conjured-water spring do not add accepted local quest outcomes. The journal records the existing exchanges without inventing those achievements.

contacts.name: Llewyn Nightshade
contacts.description: Llewyn starts on island 93335 and asks about dragon, heart and amulet. His exact heart exchange produces a letter; a separate half-amulet inspection returns the same kind. His level guidance is separate from these exchanges, and the journal does not promise his age is cured.

contacts.name: Rrmzlbbrintkmmbor, the treant elder
contacts.description: The treant elder starts at clearing 93366 in the unicorn glen. Showing a letter alone explains the stolen horn; the letter and horn together produce one half amulet. Three treant guardians follow the elder. The elder can move within the zone; a starting room is a source lead rather than a permanent meeting guarantee.

contacts.name: Tamilea, centaur elder
contacts.description: Tamilea starts in forest clearing 93386. Ask about learned, one, Banitoor or Vorsileez to hear the family history. Her corrected clue points to the eastern edge of Hateeu’s plains. Questions explain the story without awarding separate keyword achievements or granting access.

contacts.name: Banitoor Vorsileez
contacts.description: Banitoor starts in cave 93399 east of plains room 93326. PUSH the jagged rock to clear the eastern route when blocked. Ask about amulet or show a half for optional guidance; return staff 93317 for a half. Her welcome, ancestry and prayers are not additional accepted quest outcomes.

contacts.name: Hateeu, centaur elder
contacts.description: Hateeu starts at plains room 93330 and can move within the zone. Offer two distinct loose half amulets together for bracelet 93314 and legplates 93330. The native completion removes him and any remaining possessions. Fresh giver availability and daily renewal are separate from your retained completion.

contacts.name: Naergot the Black
contacts.description: Naergot starts in lair 93398, south of cave 93397 and west of incline 93305, carrying heart 93310. His static treasure container is scenery and does not itself issue a quest reward. Receiving the heart from another player satisfies the offering without proving a personal kill or first original acquisition.

contacts.name: Haornig Mardigan
contacts.description: Haornig starts at natural arch 93317 with a wolf follower, gear and backpack 93318 containing horn 93312. The hunter can wander beyond his starting room. The backpack reset finds a matching container by kind, rather than promising a particular physical source instance. No native personal-kill or theft condition is encoded for returning the horn.

contacts.name: Deiluus
contacts.description: Deiluus, the female unicorn, starts north of the treant clearing at 93367 with a guardian follower. The elder’s story describes Gilandrimeel’s death and her grief; no reviewed native widow-healing, burial or rescue exchange is implemented for her.
